% Pattern: number/springer-options. With envcountsame each environment of the
% class and each \spnewtheorem without a counter share the counter of theorem,
% and envcountsect numbers it within the section. In svmult, \maketitle steps
% the chapter and \thesection is \thechapter.\arabic{section}. Seen in the gold
% pilot (set X).
% want theorem-1 statement/theorem 6.1.1 status=none
% want lemma-1 statement/lemma 6.1.2 status=none
% want defn-1 definition 6.2.1
% want theorem-2 statement/theorem 6.2.2 status=none
\documentclass[envcountsame,envcountsect]{svmult}
\setcounter{chapter}{5}
\spnewtheorem{defn}{Definition}{\bfseries}{\rmfamily}
\begin{document}
\title{Compact spaces}
\maketitle
\section{Introduction}
\begin{theorem} Every compact space is bounded. \end{theorem}
\begin{lemma} Every closed subset of a compact space is compact. \end{lemma}
\section{Products}
\begin{defn} A space is bounded when it lies in a ball. \end{defn}
\begin{theorem} Every finite product of compact spaces is compact. \end{theorem}
\end{document}
